Day 4 recent_documents\n    (\"e15\", False), # Day 4 recent_documents\n]\n\ndef poisson_pmf(k, lam):\n    return (lam ** k) * math.exp(-lam) / math.factorial(k)\n\n# Note on framing rate for innocent non-decoy:\n# Baseline framing: Poisson(2.0) * 0.5 / 38 = Poisson(1/38 = 0.026316) per day.\n# Optional Mole DSL rule framing: either 0, decoy (0 to non-decoy), or random colleague (1/39 = 0.02564 per day).\n# Let's test both r_frame = 1/38 (default) and r_frame = 1/38 + 1/39 (if random colleague rule framing).\nfor label, extra_frame in [(\"default_framing (lam_ah_inn=0.1263)\", 0.0), (\"max_random_framing (lam_ah_inn=0.1520)\", 1/39)]:\n    print(f\"\\n=== {label} ===\")\n    scores = {}\n    for m in suspects:\n        # Note: All 11 Sales suspects had IDENTICAL regular document sets and canary recipient sizes on Days 1-3!\n        # Wait: Let's verify! On Days 1, 2, 3:\n        # Day 1: all 11 got d1-2 (17) and c1 (18).\n        # Day 2: all 11 got d2-1 (19), none got c2.\n        # Day 3: none got d3-1 or d3-2!\n        # So P(d1-2 leaked on D1/D2 AND c1 leaked on D2/D3 | mole=m) is 100% IDENTICAL for all 11 Sales suspects!!\n        # Interviews:\n        for emp, ev in interviews:\n            if emp == m:\n                logp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n            else:\n                logp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        # Access logs Days 1..4 (all 11 held docs on all 4 days):\n        for d in range(1, 5):\n            for emp in suspects:\n                day_reg = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and not ah)\n                day_ah = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and ah)\n                if emp == m:\n                    lam_reg = 0.70\n                    lam_ah = 0.30\n                else:\n                    lam_reg = 0.90\n                    lam_ah = 0.10 + (1.0 / 38.0) + extra_frame\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_reg, lam_reg))\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_ah, lam_ah))\n        scores[m] = logp\n    max_lp = max(scores.values())\n    probs = {m: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for m, lp in scores.items()}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {m: p / Z for m, p in probs.items()}\n    for m, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        v_c1 = \"A\" if m in c1_A else (\"B\" if m in c1_B else \"C\")\n        ah_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and ah)\n        reg_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and not ah)\n        print(f\"  {m} (c1={v_c1}, ah={ah_cnt}, reg={reg_cnt}): P = {p:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794723654370,"end":1794723654384}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddddaad60018llpMpiXVkzSed","sessionID":"ses_e222c5de9ffeANNPiMtyzBV82I","messageID":"msg_1dddcb1b0001El7HZaM75anHw0"}}

               day_reg = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and not ah)\n                day_ah = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and ah)\n                if math.log(poisson_pmf(day_reg, lam_reg))\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_ah, lam_ah))\n        scores[m] = logp\n    max_lp = max(scores.values())\n    probs = {m: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for m, lp in scores.items()}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {m: p / Z for m, p in probs.items()}\n    for m, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        v_c1 = \"A\" Also note: d5-2 leaked on Day 6 or Day 7 under random choice:\n        # suspects NOT in c5/c6 had higher chance of picking d5-2 on D6/D7 because fewer canary weights!\n        # Let's include exact D4 + D6/D7 random choice weight factor AND check without it too:\n        for emp, ev in interviews:\n            if emp == m:\n                logp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n            else:\n                logp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        for d in range(1, 9):\n            for emp in suspects:\n                day_reg = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and not ah)\n                day_ah = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and ah)\n                if emp == m:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.70, 0.30\n                else:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.90, 0.10 + (1.0 / 38.0) + extra_frame\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_reg, lam_reg))\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_ah, lam_ah))\n        scores[m] = logp\n    max_lp = max(scores.values())\n    probs = {m: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for m, lp in scores.items()}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {m: p / Z for m, p in probs.items()}\n    for m, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        v_c1 = \"A\" if m in c1_A else (\"B\" if m in c1_B else \"C\")\n        ah_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and ah)\n        reg_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and not ah)\n        print(f\"  {m} (c1={v_c1}, ah={ah_cnt}, reg={reg_cnt}): P = {p:.4f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794724281352,"end":1794724281372}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dde73bf00016DJ1dRpEW970PO","sessionID":"ses_e222c5de9ffeANNPiMtyzBV82I","messageID":"msg_1dde68e43001f5yQBK3kNhQgF0"}}

Let's print WITHOUT doc-selection penalty first, then WITH doc-selection penalty below!\n        for emp, ev in interviews:\n            if emp == m:\n                logp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n            else:\n                logp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        for d in range(1, 10):\n            for emp in suspects:\n                day_reg = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and not ah)\n                day_ah = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if dd == d and ee == emp and ah)\n                if emp == m:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.70, 0.30\n                else:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.90, 0.10 + (1.0 / 38.0) + extra_frame\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_reg, lam_reg))\n                logp += math.log(poisson_pmf(day_ah, lam_ah))\n        scores[m] = logp\n    max_lp = max(scores.values())\n    probs = {m: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for m, lp in scores.items()}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {m: p / Z for m, p in probs.items()}\n    for m, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:6]:\n        v_c1 = \"A\" if m in c1_A else (\"B\" if m in c1_B else \"C\")\n        ah_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and ah)\n        reg_cnt = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in logs if ee == m and not ah)\n        print(f\"  {m} (c1={v_c1}, ah={ah_cnt}, reg={reg_cnt}): P = {p:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794724399635,"end":1794724399645}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dde90a08001jyKTbK9bC9QmGT","sessionID":"ses_e222c5de9ffeANNPiMtyzBV82I","messageID":"msg_1dde871b0001j6E85l2JBhqEk0"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794724490402,"sessionID":"ses_e222c5de9ffeANNPiMtyzBV82I","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"1Z93GC0l80W4CsCI","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/ev_check.py","content":"import math\n\n# Add Day 10 interviews to Day 10 morning tracker:\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py\") as f:\n    code = f.read()\n\n# Let's append the 7 Day 10 interviews and compute exact EV of accusing now vs waiting 1 day!\nd10_interviews = [\n    (\"e18\", True),\n    (\"e18\", False),\n    (\"e18\", False),\n    (\"e18\", True),\n    (\"e27\", False),\n    (\"e27\", False),\n    (\"e27\", False),\n]\n\nimport tracker\nall_interviews = tracker.interviews + d10_interviews\n\nfor label, extra_frame in [(\"decoy_framing (lam_ah_inn=0.1263)\", 0.0), (\"random_colleague_framing (lam_ah_inn=0.1520)\", 1/39)]:\n    scores = {}\n    for m in tracker.suspects:\n        logp = math.log(0.95 if m in tracker.c1_A else 0.025)\n        for emp, ev in all_interviews:\n            if emp == m:\n                logp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n            else:\n                logp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        for d in range(1, 10):\n            for emp in tracker.suspects:\n                day_reg = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in tracker.logs if dd == d and ee == emp and not ah)\n                day_ah = sum(1 for dd, ee, ah in tracker.logs if dd == d and ee == emp and ah)\n                if emp == m:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.70, 0.30\n                else:\n                    lam_reg, lam_ah = 0.90, 0.10 + (1.0 / 38.0) + extra_frame\n                logp += math.log(tracker.poisson_pmf(day_reg, lam_reg))\n                logp += math.log(tracker.poisson_pmf(day_ah, lam_ah))\n        scores[m] = logp\n    max_lp = max(scores.values())\n    probs = {m: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for m, lp in scores.items()}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {m: p / Z for m, p in probs.items()}\n    print(f\"\\n=== After Day 10 Interviews: {label} ===\")\n    for m, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:6]:\n        print(f\"  {m}: P = {p:.4f}\")\n    p_e18 = probs[\"e18\"]\n    # True V right now is ~0.64 (if 1 unsurfaced leak from D8/D9) or ~0.615\n    for v_true in [0.69, 0.64, 0.59]:\n        ev_now = p_e18 * v_true -
